title: Chinese-Style Yakitori Chicken
description: Delicious and easy-to-make yakitori chicken dish inspired by Chinese flavors. Perfect for a quick dinner or meal prep.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, and sesame oil.
Add the chicken breasts to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the marinated chicken onto the yakitori skewers.
Grill the chicken skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, grill the sliced yellow onions for 3-4 minutes per side, or until caramelized.
To assemble the dish, place a grilled chicken skewer on each plate, top with a few slices of grilled onion, and garnish with roasted sesame seeds and scallions.
